GOBLIN
Small, green, and annoying. They love to steal shiny things.

AC 12 (leather), HP 6, ATK 1 shortbow (near) +1 (1d4) or 1 dagger (close) +1 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +2, C +0, I -1, W -1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1

Keen Senses. Goblins have advantage on Wisdom checks to detect creeping enemies.

Sneaky. Advantage on Dex checks to hide.
